title: A Garden for the Promise
author: Orsen Amberdale
blurb: Edmund Vane, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
